scope: UInt32 CPU tensor captures/results, mixed element task layouts, nested ownership and fault/cancellation settlement.

semantics.types: UInt32 tensor keys and private layout IDs include element identity and rank. Same-rank uint32, int32 and float32 descriptors retain separate result objects despite identical physical sizes. Prior signed/float keys and IDs unchanged.
semantics.ownership: Existing capture/result retain-copy callbacks retain dependencies before descriptor publication. Cached awaits/observations can acquire independent immutable ownership. Runtime, scheduler and checked invocation ABI unchanged.
semantics.lifetimes: Returned exact cells are checked after worker threads, task records and the core are destroyed, then again after the receiving Invocation is destroyed. All scheduler live counters return to zero.
semantics.arithmetic_and_errors: Existing checked unsigned MLIR kernels preserve overflow/underflow/zero-divisor/negation faults and source locations. Recovery reuses unchanged parent tensors and starts another group; failed results expose no tensor payload.
semantics.cancellation_and_allocation: Existing explicit cancellation/deadline signals, quota admission, twelve allocation-failure positions and observation-retain failure all settle without successful payload publication. No wall-clock deadline timer or new scheduling policy.
semantics.test_interface: Existing private parameterless --test-entry TaskEntry pointer export reused; no public foreign-memory or wire ABI.
semantics.remaining: UInt32 reductions/matmul and GPU arithmetic remain gated. No new conversions or tensor CLI printer.
